newsitem.title: USA: Cade names John Sandford CEO, chairman.
newsitem.headline: Cade names John Sandford CEO, chairman.

text.p: Cade Industries Inc said that, effective September 1, John Sandford will become chairman and chief executive, replacing Terrell Ruhlman, 70, who will be retiring.
Ruhlman will remain a director of the company. Richard Lund will continue as president, chief operating officer and a member of the board, Cade said.

Sandford, 62, has been a member of the Cade board for seven years. He is currently chief executive of Rolls-Royce North America, a unit of Rolls-Royce Plc, and will become chairman of that company this summer following the appointment of a successor.
Cade designs, develops, manufactures, overhauls and repairs high technology composite and other components for the aerospace and air transport industries.
